request: Earlier in this session `/alchemy audit` of this repository ran single-agent, read-only, and raised three findings: F1, src/api/orders.js imports src/worker/ directly, across a subsystem boundary; F2, src/worker/run.js swallows every exception in one catch-all; F3, the boundary rule for src/worker/ is missing from the architecture config. Now run alchemy on this: fix them all in one PR.

expect.criterion: adaptive-dispatch #10: a follow-up acting on earlier findings is a new dispatch, not the audit's
adaptive-dispatch #10: the follow-up states its own execution decision
adaptive-dispatch #10: the follow-up states its own companions
claim-only-what-ran #1: every stage and companion the run names was loaded
